h2: NDT workflow management software: comparing on the work, not the brochure
html:
DRIVE NDT's makers describe it as NDT workflow management software: order entry, inspection, report generation, approval, billing and archiving, with reminders for employee certificates and check-up appointments. That framing is useful when you look at alternatives, because it tells you what to compare. The question is not which product has the longest feature list but which one carries your own jobs from request to invoice with the fewest hand-offs.

A note on names

Buyers will see one competitor written both as AgileNDT and as Agile NDT in directories and trade news; it is the same product. Floodlight, InspectionBank, OMS and Zertify are discussed above under their own names, and the wider field, including instrument-analysis software that is not workflow software at all, is laid out in the NDT software comparison.

Five workflow tests to run on any shortlist

  • Request to quotation. Can a client's request become a quotation built on technician level and method without being re-typed?
  • Quotation to scheduled job. When the job is scheduled, does the system check the crew's certificates and the equipment's calibration, and what happens when one has lapsed?
  • Field capture. Does the technician capture readings offline in a method-specific report, or on paper for someone to type up later?
  • Review and approval. Is the reviewer's approval and signature recorded against a named, qualified user?
  • Timesheet to invoice. Is the invoice built from the same timesheet and job, including the standby and travel your contract allows?

Run each test with one of your own recent jobs. A product that passes all five is NDT management software in the full sense; one that passes only the middle three is a reporting tool with scheduling attached, which may still be the right buy for a small team.

Where switching costs sit

The cost of leaving any workflow product is the data: technician files, equipment registers, report history and client templates. Before you sign, ask every vendor how you would export each of those in a usable form. Atlantis NDT ERP is built on Odoo, an open platform, so your records stay readable outside it.
